Instructions: Drag & drop .avi cali file into ImageJ > Ok
Using the line tool, drag the longest line possible across the ruler. Use the side of the ruler that has the small 0.5 mm tick marks. The longer the distance of the line, the less error
Use Ctrl+"plus" and Ctrl+"minus" to zoom in and out
Get the exact distance; if you put the line starting on the right side of the black tick mark, then make sure the line ends on the right side of the black tick mark
Analyze > Set scale > Copy & Paste the distance in pixels into the spreadsheet
Count how many mm the line covers; enter into spreadsheet (I like to choose round distances, like 50, 60, 70 mm so I don't have any human math/counting errors)
Exit out of the "set scale" window by hitting "cancel." Exit out of the video. Load a new video.

notes: no numbers visible on the ruler
